hypothesis: The unchanged rolling-accepted SPEED-01 candidates improve 2024 probability quality against their family-specific PACE-01 incumbents.
selection_role: one-shot milestone confirmation; not a parameter, mapping, feature, or calibration selection dataset

decision_rule.supported: Log Loss paired CI lower bound > 0 and Brier/NDCG/Top-1 points >= -0.001/-0.002/-0.005
decision_rule.directionally_consistent: Log Loss point > 0 with all guardrails, but its CI includes zero
decision_rule.contradicted: Log Loss paired CI upper bound < 0 or any guardrail fails
